$schema_comment: Machine-readable companion to GLOBAL_PHILOSOPHY_INTEGRATION_MATRIX.md — update both together. Promotion rule: only add automation.checker_ids when the checker verifies the law at the row's scope (path-level vs structural presence); see docs/01_TRUTH/README.md.

philosophies.name: Traceability
philosophies.law: Every AI-touching path emits a client trace, server trace, or a named exempt in aiTraceExemptRegistry.ts.
philosophies.intended_scope: All cockpit LLM/AI outcomes: VE API routes, /run modes, content, meeting extract, core profile LLM, transcribe, operator tools if unified.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: AI_ACTION_SUBSTRATE_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md + charter_enforcement_check.py manifest; charter-trace-exempt comments; optional pytest matrix/registry parity.

automation.notes: schema_ui_drift enforces ve_integration_schema UI label anchors for VE integration surfaces (narrow static check). trace_coverage flags cockpit FE callers missing client AiActionTrace signals vs ai_trace_exemptions.json.

philosophies.name: Mirror graph interpretation
philosophies.law: Evidence is classified against a graph and yields inspectable action + payload before durable writes—not only free text.
philosophies.intended_scope: Intake → VE, meetings → VE, profile reconcile, file steward, presort, harvest when graph-addressable.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: MIRROR_GRAPH_INTERPRETATION_SYSTEM_NOTE.md + PR checklist; shared TS/Python types when second surface.

automation.notes: Structural: canonical interpret_against_graph + required extract wiring; forbid row['interpretation'] assignment outside graph_interpretation.py; heuristics for parallel surfaces.

philosophies.name: Data access policy
philosophies.law: Reads of sensitive depth (Tier B/C, external egress) go through data_access with explicit tier/justification.
philosophies.intended_scope: Any module that could fetch raw body, external destinations, or future Tier B/C UI.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: Lint/grep gate for get_item_with_content; CODEBASE_INVENTORY.md exceptions; TRUTH_CONVERGENCE gate for new Tier B/C API.

automation.notes: Phase 3B structural: policy module + request_access; extend to path-level Tier B/C when scope is locked.

philosophies.name: Judgment substrate
philosophies.law: SubjectRef + JudgmentTrunk (and approved choke points) are the canonical shape for persisted interpretation rows.
philosophies.intended_scope: Council, node memory, coordination readings, new verdict persistence.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: CODEBASE_TRUTH_RULES.md §5b–5c; PR checklist; no revival of tombstoned adapters (grep CI).

philosophies.name: Coordination spine
philosophies.law: ActivityEvent + optional execution_flow_reading judgments link execution facts to bounded interpretation.
philosophies.intended_scope: Meaningful execution checkpoints influencing guidance without new stores.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: tests/test_coordination_signals.py extensions; CODEBASE_TRUTH_RULES.md §5c; forbid new append_node_judgment for execution_flow_reading outside coordination_signals.py.

philosophies.name: Canonical core identity
philosophies.law: One canonical core profile per user/workspace as product truth; perspectives as lenses—not many competing cores.
philosophies.intended_scope: Core profile list/detail/training/reconcile; server perspective definitions.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: Resolver helper FE+BE; TRUTH_CONVERGENCE + checklist; optional eslint on raw [0] without helper.

automation.notes: canonical_identity_leaks: profiles[0] on FE. check_canonical_identity: alternate list names [0], api/ + local_ai/ profiles[0], risky .find without primary/canonical/equality.

philosophies.name: Execution seam coherence
philosophies.law: Routed VE/run execution uses seam + principal with declared ollama/openai primaries unless extended in truth rules + main.py together.
philosophies.intended_scope: User-attributed LLM calls that should honor settings and blocking.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: No new get_default_provider call sites without CODEBASE_TRUTH_RULES update; inventory table; pytest smoke when touching api/main.py routing.

automation.notes: execution_seam_bypasses: get_default_provider + JSON structural checks. check_execution_seam_surface: apply_seam_routing module present (Phase 3C structural).

philosophies.name: Honest commit / explicit payload
philosophies.law: Confirmed writes use explicit structured payload (e.g. [DRAFT_VALUE:], patches)—not silent inference from chat text.
philosophies.intended_scope: Council integration commit, VE field apply, AI-said-save paths.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: charter_enforcement_check.py inference path visibility; checklist on new commit surfaces.

automation.notes: integration_commit contract fragments + audited infer_draft_value_from_context call sites in atria_tools.py.

philosophies.name: HTTP client frontier consistency
philosophies.law: VE subtree uses proxied relative VISION_EXECUTION_API; organizer uses API_BASE—no third ad-hoc origin.

philosophies.name: Intake operational completeness
philosophies.law: If schema claims sync/mailbox observability, writers exist on the real poll path—or docs say not wired.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: BOOT_FLOW.md + ACTIVE_VS_PLANNED; optional integration tests when poll touched.

philosophies.name: Product honesty (no phantom capability)
philosophies.law: UI labels and nav match runtime behavior (Tier A only, no fake AI, no hidden tiers).
philosophies.intended_scope: User-visible cockpit strings and entry routes.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: charter_enforcement_check.py Clarify stub; matrix row per AI affordance; TRUTH_CONVERGENCE gate on Tier UI.

automation.notes: product_honesty_phantom: handler must call api/fetch when label present. check_product_honesty: literal/regex sweep on cockpit copy (Tier B/C, Clarify with AI).

philosophies.name: Developmental guidance boundary
philosophies.law: Guidance is hypothesis-level optional context for council—not silent routing, not durable profile truth.
philosophies.intended_scope: Council preflight + cockpit panel until re-chartered.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: ATRIA_SYSTEM_CHARTER; forbid new consumers without SYSTEM_REFERENCE row; test scoped path omits guidance.

philosophies.name: Shared artifacts / Radar / node substrate (roadmap)
philosophies.law: Planned durable artifacts and radar aggregation—not current product law.
philosophies.intended_scope: Future council runs, next-step, signals UI.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: Do not implement without SYSTEM_REFERENCE phase + TRUTH_CONVERGENCE update.

philosophies.name: Soil filesystem substrate
philosophies.law: v1 frozen: append/promote only; no read hooks, council consumption, or vectors until re-charter.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: TRUTH_CONVERGENCE/charter pointer; CI soil routes not in user nav prod; SOIL_LAYER spec.

philosophies.name: Operator / Studio surfaces
philosophies.law: Cockpit trace law does not apply until Studio aligns with AiActionTrace contract.
philosophies.enforcement_mechanism: Keep studio_admin_surface in exempt registry; review on Studio/cockpit merge.
